verdict: Meta is back on and delivering leads at a strong cost per lead.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 15 leads from Meta at $12.60 per lead on $188.94 in total spend — an efficient return for the budget deployed. Campaigns were paused for roughly 20 days earlier in the period and reactivated October 24th; the four days since reactivation are running at a pace of approximately 4 leads per day at an even lower cost per lead, which is a positive early signal. Google Business Profile generated 170 organic actions this period including 110 direction requests, though call volume from those profiles remains low relative to impressions and is being monitored. Pipeline tracking is being repaired this week, so lead intake visibility after the initial contact is currently limited; that fix is the immediate priority heading into next period.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period via Meta ads
cost per lead — efficient for this market

watch_item.issue: Pipeline tracking is currently offline, meaning leads that come in cannot be followed through the intake funnel.
watch_item.fix: The connection is being restored now; full visibility is expected to be confirmed before next week's report.
